This
procedure details the patrol visual inspection I1 of energized circuit breaker
should be carried out on a monthly base as indicated by M1 in the above title
block.

This inspection is done during the patrol of the
switchyard, there is no need to open the doors or covers of the operating
mechanism housing and control cabinet for this inspection, if the SF6 gas low
pressure alarm is given, SF6 gas should be supplied until the gas pressure
reaches the rated gas pressure. The SF6 gas can be supplied even with the
breaker energized.

Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
procedure details the patrol visual inspection I1 of energized circuit breaker
should be carried out on a monthly base as indicated by M1 in the above title
block.
This inspection is done during the patrol of the
switchyard, there is no need to open the doors or covers of the operating
mechanism housing and control cabinet for this inspection, if the SF6 gas low
pressure alarm is given, SF6 gas should be supplied until the gas pressure
reaches the rated gas pressure. The SF6 gas can be supplied even with the
breaker energized.
Safety Precautions
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
The circuit
breaker must be isolated completely and grounded on both sides,
Ensure that
